verdict.rationale: Trello's own support docs on Power-Ups include an entry titled "Import data into Trello", so it has a documented import capability. Beyond that heading, the pack gives no detail on which source tools are supported, what data migrates, or how the process works. General Power-Up claims about pulling data from outside services describe live integrations rather than migration, so they are not credited. Missing for 10: supported source tools, scope and fidelity of imported data (cards, comments, attachments, members), step-by-step import documentation, and independent or hands-on confirmation that switching via import works.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can import my data from another tool when switching over
